findings.title: Exact solution has a factor-two error in gradient-flow time
findings.source_claim: The explicit gamma-based solution solves the stated half-squared-loss gradient flow.
findings.suspect_step: Eq89 swaps S0/Sigma0 combinations and doubles the Riccati coefficient; exponential uses -4Dt/Z instead of -2Dt/Z.

check.method: analytic reconstruction plus independent symbolic check

findings.alternative_reading: On A>0,S>0,Z>0, the published path is the correct path at2t. A globally doubled learning rate or loss without1/2 would be consistent only after changing the corresponding clock elsewhere; Eqs2,6,9,16-17,71/77 use the original clock.
findings.impact: Major: invalid exact-time dynamics in an explicitly listed mathematical contribution. w_published(t)=w_correct(2t), so finite-time values are not generally twice their correct values; derivatives equal twice the correct derivatives at2t, and attained absolute threshold times are halved. No empirical-figure consequence established.

repair.statement: For S>0,Z>0,A=Sigma0+S0>0, replace exp(-4Dt/Z) by exp(-2Dt/Z) in74/96 and use gamma'=-(A gamma^2-2S gamma-B)/Z.
repair.verification: analytic proof; independent SymPy exact residual

findings.core_dependency: The explicitly listed Section7 toy-model contribution advertises exact general-initialization dynamics (Theorem3). The theorem's limiting gamma_plus and final products are then used for the weight-to-target rich/lazy criterion. The exact-time trajectory is invalid in the paper's fixed clock; the endpoint-based criterion survives on A>0.
counterevidence: Section7.1 p8 actually uses gamma_plus and limiting products; these and the endpoint weight-to-target criterion survive on A>0.
Parameter-space path, endpoints, common-rescaling threshold-time ratios and stationary trajectories survive.
Special-case equations on p7 and the balanced-mode Eq9 are not invalidated.
No dependence of empirical Figure8 curves on the erroneous closed form was established.
findings.calibration_basis: The error is closely tied to the advertised exact-dynamics contribution. Surviving endpoint conclusions narrow the damage but do not make that derivation peripheral under the clarified standard.

findings.title: Released Figure6(b) imbalance-axis sign and magnitude mismatch
findings.source_claim: The plotted vertical coordinate represents sigma1-sigma2.
findings.alternative_reading: Original figure might use a different script or data; no data/run logs tie released checkout to publication.
findings.impact: Reverses heavier-layer interpretation and multiplies axis magnitude by ten in released plot pipeline; published data provenance unresolved.

repair.statement: Derive labels from actual saved grid, or explicitly reverse rows with correspondingly reversed +/-0.5 endpoints. Avoid claiming exact zero at a nonzero grid row.
repair.verification: analytic mapping only; original arrays not rerendered

scope_clarifications.statement: Finite-equilibrium expression requires A>0. For A=0 all initial pairs are anti-aligned; gamma=(1+Sigma0/S)exp(2St/Z)-Sigma0/S, theta tends to0 and loss toS^2/2.
scope_clarifications.verification: analytic derivation and symbolic residuals both zero

pending_subitems.observation: Current initializer gives product singular values sqrt(s), while targets are divided by s.

calibration.scope: Targeted severity/dependency reassessment of an existing demonstrated finding; unchanged evidence and no new finding.
calibration.standard: A demonstrated invalid derivation closely tied to a core contribution, or material damage to a core conclusion, normally supports Major. Whole-paper failure, loss of the broad research agenda, or changed benchmark scores is not required. Ease of repair and survival of a qualitative rate do not alone determine severity. Peripheral errors may remain Minor; there is no target count of Major findings.
calibration.standard_origin: Human clarification of intended NeurIPS batch_1 grading standard, applied to the authorized B001 follow-up.
calibration.verified_domain: Positive integer p; S>0, Z>0, finite real initial parameters, standard-normal input for the explicit checks. Finite-equilibrium correction requires A=Sigma0+S0>0; the A=0 all-anti-aligned branch remains separately recorded in SC01. No extension to Z<=0.
